title: Chicken Tortilla Soup in the Instant Pot
description: This Instant Pot chicken tortilla soup is totally customizable and family-friendly. Don't have an Instant Pot? Don't worry — use your slow cooker!
ingredients: 2 (10 ounce) cans diced tomatoes and green chiles (such as RO*TEL®)
1 pinch chili powder, or to taste
0.5 cup crushed tortilla chips, or to taste

steps.text: Combine chicken broth, diced tomatoes and chiles, chicken, black beans, enchilada sauce, corn, onion, garlic, cumin, salt, pepper, and chili powder in a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot). Close and lock the lid. Select the Poultry setting according to the manufacturer's instructions; set the timer for 15 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
Release the pressure using the natural-release method according to the manufacturer's instructions, about 10 minutes. Unlock and remove the lid.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks. Return chicken to soup. Ladle into individual bowls and top with crushed tortilla chips.
